get.description: Return the current dial value and acknowledge state.

put.description:
Update the dial value.

Safety rules:
- dial > 0 requires blocking_acknowledged
- Max 10 changes per UTC hour
- dial = 0 is always allowed (emergency monitor mode)

post.description:
Acknowledge that raising the dial will cause blocking.

Must be called before setting dial > 0.

schema.title: Response Acknowledge Dial Api V1 Dial Acknowledge Post

get.description: Estimate what percentage of recent traffic would be blocked at a given dial value.

schema.title: Response Get Counterfactual Impact Api V1 Dial Counterfactual Get

get.description: Return the current state of all 8 security policy bypasses.

schema.title: Response List Bypasses Api V1 Policy Bypasses Get

put.description:
Enable or disable a security policy bypass.

Writes to policy:bypass:{name} and publishes config_reload.
WARN logged when disabling an ALLOW bypass (increases false positive risk).

schema.title: Response Update Bypass Api V1 Policy Bypasses  Bypass Name  Put
